label: Minimum cell voltage
description: Lowest instantaneous cell voltage in the assessed population.

label: Maximum cell voltage
description: Highest instantaneous cell voltage in the assessed population.

label: Cell voltage spread
description: Maximum minus minimum cell voltage at comparable SOC and load.

label: Cell voltage standard deviation
description: Population dispersion at comparable SOC and load.

label: Rest-voltage drift
description: Open-circuit voltage change after thermal and SOC correction.

label: Self-discharge rate
description: SOC or capacity loss while isolated at controlled temperature.

label: Leakage current
description: Unexpected steady current with the cell or string isolated.

label: Coulombic efficiency
description: Discharge ampere-hours divided by charge ampere-hours.

label: Cell energy efficiency
description: Cell-level discharge energy divided by charge energy.

label: Balancing duty
description: Share of the observation window with active balancing.

label: Capacity retention
description: Measured usable capacity relative to beginning-of-life reference.

label: Energy retention
description: Measured usable energy relative to beginning-of-life reference.

label: Available energy
description: Currently dispatchable energy inside configured operating limits.

label: Cell capacity spread
description: Maximum cell-capacity deviation across the population.

label: String capacity spread
description: Usable-capacity variation between parallel strings.

label: Last charge energy
description: Energy absorbed during the selected charge interval.

label: Last discharge energy
description: Energy delivered during the selected discharge interval.

label: Lifetime energy throughput
description: Cumulative charged plus discharged energy.

label: Equivalent full cycles
description: Throughput normalized to rated usable energy.

label: DC resistance growth
description: Pulse-derived DCIR change from commissioning baseline.

label: Cell DCIR spread
description: Maximum comparable cell-resistance deviation.

label: Rack resistance spread
description: Effective-resistance variation between racks.

label: Connection resistance growth
description: Busbar, cable, fuse, and joint resistance change.

label: Charge power capability
description: BMS-permitted charge power after active derates.

label: Discharge power capability
description: BMS-permitted discharge power after active derates.

label: Voltage sag at rated discharge
description: DC voltage reduction under a defined power step.

label: Voltage recovery time
description: Settling time after a defined current interruption.

label: SOC estimation error
description: Difference between BMS SOC and a validated reference.

label: String SOC spread
description: Maximum SOC difference between comparable strings.

label: SOH estimation error
description: Difference between reported SOH and capacity-test result.

label: SOE estimation error
description: Difference between estimated and measured remaining energy.

label: SOC drift per cycle
description: Uncorrected estimator drift over a representative cycle.

label: Measurement time-sync error
description: Timestamp misalignment between measurement sources.

label: EIS ohmic resistance growth
description: High-frequency resistance change from reference spectrum.

label: Charge-transfer resistance growth
description: Mid-frequency kinetic resistance change.

label: Diffusion impedance growth
description: Low-frequency mass-transport impedance change.

label: ICA peak shift
description: Incremental-capacity peak displacement from reference.

label: DVA feature shift
description: Differential-voltage feature displacement from baseline.

label: Relaxation anomaly index
description: Post-pulse relaxation deviation from the healthy baseline.

label: Minimum cell temperature
description: Lowest cell temperature in the selected interval.

label: Maximum cell temperature
description: Highest cell temperature in the selected interval.

label: Cell temperature spread
description: Maximum temperature difference within a module or rack.

label: Rack temperature spread
description: Maximum temperature difference between racks.

label: Maximum temperature rise rate
description: Fastest observed cell or module temperature increase.

label: Redundant sensor disagreement
description: Difference between colocated temperature sensors.

label: Thermal-image hotspot delta
description: Hotspot above comparable neighboring hardware.

label: Ambient temperature
description: Air temperature at the relevant enclosure or intake.

label: Thermal derating
description: Power capability removed by thermal constraints.

label: Thermal-model residual
description: Measured temperature minus model prediction.

label: Coolant supply temperature
description: Liquid temperature entering battery cold plates.

label: Coolant return temperature
description: Liquid temperature leaving battery cold plates.

label: Coolant temperature rise
description: Return minus supply temperature under load.

label: Coolant flow
description: Measured loop flow relative to required design flow.

label: Coolant pressure
description: Loop pressure relative to normal setpoint.

label: Coolant leak events
description: Detected leakage events in the selected period.

label: Fans/pumps available
description: Commanded fans or pumps confirmed operational.

label: HVAC capacity margin
description: Remaining thermal capacity at assessed conditions.

label: Air-filter pressure drop
description: Restriction relative to replacement/alarm limit.

label: Condensation-risk events
description: Periods where surfaces fell below calculated dew point.

label: Maximum cell swelling
description: Cell thickness change from accepted baseline.

label: Module compression
description: Compressive load relative to designed target.

label: Terminal torque deviation
description: Absolute deviation from approved fastener target.

label: Enclosure deformation index
description: Maximum deformation relative to accepted geometry.

label: Vibration RMS
description: Equipment vibration velocity under steady operation.

label: Water-ingress detections
description: Validated liquid ingress or wetness detections.

label: Module voltage spread
description: Module-voltage deviation at comparable SOC/load.

label: Rack voltage spread
description: Rack-voltage deviation across parallel assets.

label: String current spread
description: Current-sharing deviation between parallel strings.

label: String power spread
description: Power-sharing deviation between parallel strings.

label: Rack availability
description: Racks capable of service relative to installed racks.

label: Offline racks
description: Racks unavailable for dispatch.

label: Contactor voltage drop
description: Drop across a closed main contactor at defined current.

label: Precharge completion time
description: Time to reach accepted DC-link voltage ratio.

label: Fuse temperature delta
description: Fuse/holder temperature above comparable hardware.

label: Busbar joint temperature delta
description: Connection hotspot above similar loaded joints.

label: Insulation resistance
description: HV-to-chassis resistance; replace defaults with OEM limits.

label: Insulation resistance change
description: Reduction from a dry, healthy baseline.

label: Ground-fault events
description: Validated ground-fault detections in the period.

label: Protection trips
description: Battery, PCS, or switchgear protection operations.

label: Unexplained trip rate
description: Protection operations without confirmed initiating fault.

label: Breaker opening time
description: Measured clearing time for the relevant breaker.

label: Failed weld checks
description: Contactor weld-detection test failures.

label: Emergency-stop test failures
description: Failed emergency-stop channels or functional tests.

label: Interlock test failures
description: Failed door, disconnect, or permissive interlocks.

label: Sensor plausibility faults
description: Voltage, current, or temperature plausibility failures.

label: Off-gas concentration
description: Installed off-gas sensor maximum; use certified alarm limits.

label: Hydrogen concentration
description: Installed hydrogen-sensor maximum.

label: Carbon monoxide concentration
description: Installed CO sensor maximum.

label: Smoke alarm events
description: Validated smoke detections in the period.

label: Fire-panel faults
description: Detection, notification, suppression, or supervision faults.

label: Suppression system available
description: Required suppression zones in normal/ready state.

label: Emergency ventilation available
description: Required exhaust devices available and proven.

label: Gas sensors available
description: Installed gas channels reporting valid data.

label: PCS efficiency
description: Converter efficiency at representative load.

label: PCS availability
description: Converter capacity available for dispatch.

label: Active-power tracking error
description: Absolute error between commanded and measured power.

label: Reactive-power tracking error
description: Absolute reactive-power command error.

label: Power response time
description: Time to enter tolerance after a command step.

label: Current THD
description: Total harmonic distortion at the defined measurement point.

label: DC-link current ripple
description: AC ripple component relative to DC current.

label: DC-bus imbalance
description: Difference between split-bus voltages or parallel inputs.

label: Grid voltage unbalance
description: Negative-sequence or phase voltage unbalance.

label: PCS faults
description: Converter faults in the selected period.

label: Transformer top-oil temperature
description: Highest top-oil temperature in the period.

label: Transformer winding temperature
description: Highest indicated or calculated winding hotspot.

label: Transformer loading
description: Maximum apparent-power loading.

label: DGA condition index
description: Worst dissolved-gas result normalized to alarm.

label: Auxiliary load
description: HVAC, controls, pumps, heaters, and standby load.

label: Control UPS runtime
description: Validated ride-through time for critical controls.

label: DC round-trip efficiency
description: Battery-side discharge energy divided by charge energy.

label: AC round-trip efficiency
description: Grid-side discharge energy divided by charge energy.

label: Technical availability
description: Time technically capable of operation.

label: Energy tracking error
description: Delivered-energy deviation from command/test profile.

label: Response repeatability
description: Variation across repeated equal commands.

label: Standby/parasitic loss
description: Consumption while enabled but not dispatching.

label: Total plant derating
description: Unavailable power due to active constraints.

label: Black-start test success
description: Successful tests where designed and commissioned.

label: Dispatch command success
description: Valid commands completed without rejection or timeout.

label: Average depth of discharge
description: Mean cycle depth; compare with the warranted duty profile.

label: High-SOC dwell
description: Time above the configured high-SOC threshold.

label: Low-SOC dwell
description: Time below the configured low-SOC threshold.

label: Maximum charge C-rate
description: Highest sustained normalized charge current.

label: Maximum discharge C-rate
description: Highest sustained normalized discharge current.

label: High-temperature exposure
description: Time above the configured normal temperature range.

label: Maximum relative humidity
description: Highest enclosure or room humidity reading.

label: Contamination index
description: Dust, salt, or conductive contamination vs approved limit.

label: Missing telemetry
description: Expected samples absent from the interval.

label: Stale telemetry
description: Channels whose values or timestamps are not updating.

label: Calibration-overdue channels
description: Channels beyond their calibration interval.

label: BMS communication errors
description: CRC, timeout, packet-loss, or offline events.
